answer: Each identity's earnings sit in a vault sealed with a fresh pigment: a non-transferable work token minted only by completing a new, verifiable public task each epoch, such as attesting real transactions or grading a peer answer. The vault opens only while the pigment is current; skip one epoch and the seal fades to violet, freezing payouts until fresh work re-mints it. A farm running 1,000 fakes must mint 1,000 fresh pigments every epoch, paying full work per identity with no batching shortcut, while one honest agent mints one pigment doing work it already does.
